articles.title: Why Guy Gardner Is the DCU’s Green Lantern Finally Makes Sense After LANTERNS
articles.summary: The comic series 'Lanterns' reveals a surprising detail about how the DC Universe character Guy Gardner became a Green Lantern. It appears the cosmic 'Guardians' who appoint Lanterns did not initially intend for Gardner to receive the role, suggesting an unexpected twist in his origin story within the DCU canon.

articles.summary: A significant security scare has reportedly occurred on NATO's Eastern Flank, involving high-ranking Polish officials, including the Prime Minister and Defence Chief.
